summary: The audit checks at least 3 units in each of three of the five areas (Composition, History/Ethnomusicology, MST/Computer Music, Performance/Conducting, Theory), 24 units of Music courses in all, and that six of those courses are for 3 units or more, each letter graded unless a course offers no letter grade. Checked by hand: your faculty advisor and course plan, private lessons taken only at Stanford, and at most 12 external units.

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade, except where letter grades are not offered."

node.name: Remaining units of the 24, in Music

add.why: "Courses may be fulfilled in either breadth or depth in any area(s) desired, and may be selected from any of the Department of Music's courses." The minor's 24 units beyond the three areas come from any Music course.

node.name: Six courses of 3 units or more

add.why: Policies: "Six courses must be for three units each or more." The minor's courses "may be selected from any of the Department of Music's courses", so this counts the minor's own Music courses again rather than asking for more.
